Yoga instructor names and days: this schedule lives on a Squarespace page that is not obviously dated. Call (619) 299-1124 or check the SD front desk before seeding. Instructor swaps are the most likely thing to be stale.

Huckfest is CONFIRMED off the RockGymPro registration page: Thu Sep 17 2026, two heats, recreational 6:30-7:30pm and competitive 7:35-8:35pm. Seeded as one entry spanning 18:30-20:35. The page has a Schedule tab that was never captured — check whether check-in opens before 6:30.
Coordinates came off Google's own place pin for Vertical Hold, not a geocoded guess — but drop it once to confirm it lands on the building and not the Hancock St frontage.

items.title: Power Vinyasa at Vertical Hold
items.description: Monday night power vinyasa with Ishmael. All levels, no reservation needed, and free with a day pass or membership. Mats and blocks are there if you don't bring your own. The instructors climb, so the sequencing is built around what climbers are usually tight in.

items.title: Vinyasa with Meghan at Vertical Hold
items.description: Tuesday all-levels vinyasa with Meghan. Drop in without booking. Included with a membership or a day pass, so it's one of the cheapest yoga classes around here if you were already going to climb.

items.title: Vinyasa with Karey at Vertical Hold
items.description: Wednesday all-levels vinyasa with Karey. Same deal as the rest of the week: walk in, no reservation, mats provided.

items.title: Slow Flow Restorative at Vertical Hold
items.description: Thursday restorative class with Melissa. Slower and lower intensity than the vinyasa nights - this is the one to go to if you climbed hard earlier in the week and your forearms are wrecked.

items.title: Sendtember Huckfest
items.description: Vertical Hold's annual dyno comp, run as two back-to-back heats on one night. Recreational goes first at 6:30, competitive follows at 7:35. Mens, womens, and non-binary divisions in both. The gym's guide is V0 to V3 for recreational and V4 and up for competitive, and they pitch the rec heat as beginner and first-timer friendly - you pick your own category on the scorecard and the judges can move you if it's a mismatch. Ages 13 and up only, since no youth-sized dynos get set. Registration is cheapest through August 31 and steps up twice after that; online sign-ups close the night of September 16, then it's day-of at the front desk. Entry includes a shirt while they last. Register: https://app.rockgympro.com/b/widget/?a=list&widget_guid=fe5ced1c60fa42f998b56e605d0d3775&mode=p
